title: Owner Auto Policy Fee Schedule
content:
**Fees on the Owner Auto Policy (all Cardinal Point liability packages).**

| Fee | Amount (USD) | When it is charged |
|---|---|---|
| Policy fee, new business | 25 | Once, when a new-business term is bound |
| Policy fee, renewal | 15 | Once, when a renewal term is accepted |
| Reinstatement fee | 25 | Once for each reinstatement with a lapse in coverage |

The same amounts apply on every package:

| Package | New-business policy fee | Renewal policy fee | Reinstatement fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | 25.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 |
| Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability | 25.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 |
| Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | 25.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | 25.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability | 25.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 |
| Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability | 25.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 |

**The package's reinstatement fee in the schedule.** The schedule describes the package's reinstatement fee as the fully earned fee charged once for each reinstatement with a lapse in coverage. For a reinstatement with lapse, the reinstatement fee charged is charged once, at the amount the company's state schedule works out for that reinstatement. A rescission, or a reinstatement without lapse, is still charged no reinstatement fee.

**Return of fees on cancellation (all packages).** Fully earned fees are not returned when a term cancels. There are two exceptions: a fee the company charged in error is reversed, and the policy fee of a term voided from inception for a dishonored down payment is reversed.

**Fee questions answered.**
- *Is the policy fee refunded when the insured cancels mid-term?* No. Fees are fully earned and are not returned on cancellation.
- *Does the renewal policy fee differ by package?* No. It is 15.00 on every package.
